structure: Programme notes (Markdown, PROGRAMME-NOTES.md, no author or date in the file; its rulings are dated by the notes themselves, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-07) for the DR1 parity union: the union of two independent runs comparing the live-animals frontend against Design release 1 of the GB-notification-service prototype, 161 increments. Sections in order: (1) What the backlog is; (2) Standing rulings, a table with columns Increment and Ruling (inc-062, inc-094, inc-030, inc-031, inc-013); (3) The dashboard and the address book are blocked as groups (Rhys, 2026-08-28); (4) The address space is blocked while the team works in it (Rhys, 2026-09-04); (5) Reference-data lists come from MDM, not from this backlog (Rhys, 2026-09-07); (6) inc-161 carries its own design decision (rule b); (7) Seven increments disagree about banding; (8) Provenance, and why ids look odd; (9) Evidence lives in the per-run reports; (10) Pins; (11) Target; (12) Disputed increments are deferred to their own pass (Rhys, 2026-09-04). Whole file read, as scoped. Per the source's role this extract records DR1 judgements only; build-process method and run logistics (provenance fields, report paths) are recorded only where they bear on a judgement. Every inc-NNN is a DR1 parity backlog id, not a union-neutral id.

claims.statement: The notes judge differences between the real frontend and Design release 1 only. They do not say whether any ruling (dropped, rejected, blocked or deferred) carries over to Design Release 2.1, or whether DR2.1 changed the pages the rulings concern.
